name: KIMA
description: Purpose-built medical-grade 7-axis robotic arm designed for OEM integration into surgical and clinical systems. Weighs 12.6 kg with a 750 mm reach, 3 kg payload, <0.1 mm repeatability, and <1 mm accuracy. Controller-less design using EtherCAT communication and a Robotic Control Library (RCL) compliant with IEC 62304 Class C. Features redundant torque sensors in all joints and integrated safety architecture. Engineered for compliance with IEC 60601-1 and IEC 62304 Class C software standards. Produced by Kinova, an ISO 13485-certified manufacturer. Distinct from the research-oriented Gen3 arm; KIMA is built from the ground up for operating room and clinical environments.
